boundary: Data-only POSITION/XYZWPREXT support. No implicit orientation, frame/group context, positional conversion, kinematics or controller runtime equivalence is introduced.

rules.feature: POSITION field shape and access modes
rules.documented: POSITION exposes NORMAL, ORIENT and APPROACH as read-only VECTOR fields; LOCATION is read-write VECTOR and CONFIG_DATA is read-write CONFIG. Position values refer to a coordinate frame; the manual separately permits positional conversion and lists frame operators.
rules.implemented: POSITION declarations, local storage, nested structure fields, fixed/named arrays and exact-type reference parameters. Writable LOCATION scalar/whole-vector access and CONFIG_DATA scalar/whole-CONFIG access use the existing checked types. Read-only orientation vectors and scalar components can be read or queried for scalar initialization.
rules.restriction: Every orientation scalar leaf starts uninitialized. No source initializer, identity orientation, POS/UNPOS constructor, register input or positional conversion is synthesized. LOCATION/CONFIG_DATA writes do not initialize orientation; complete POSITION copying still requires every source leaf initialized.
rules.tests: tests/test_position_data.py: field forms, initialization, arrays/references and writable location/configuration checks

rules.documented: NORMAL/ORIENT/APPROACH are labeled read-only in Figure A.16.15. No distinct bare-argument behavior for their subfields is established by this entry.
rules.implemented: Direct or nested assignments and conversion outputs under these three fields are rejected with E_POSITION_READ_ONLY. Runtime ReadOnlyFieldReference also blocks set/clear on whole vectors and scalar descendants. Orientation subtree protection is established by destination context and survives cloning/copying within POSITION, structures and arrays. A detached initialized VECTOR value copy becomes independently writable.
rules.restriction: Bare orientation vector/scalar arguments are conservatively rejected with E_POSITION_READ_ONLY_ARG, including calls whose formal is read only. Explicit scalar expression/value arguments can read initialized contents. Explicitly grouped initialized VECTOR values can detach into writable copies under vector_routine_semantics.json; other exact-type positional values use positional_routine_semantics.json. Protection applies to supported KAREL source/runtime accessors, not to arbitrary host mutation of private prototype state.
rules.tests: tests/test_position_data.py: nested targets, arguments, conversion outputs, runtime alias/set/clear guards and copy-context ownership

rules.implemented: Exact-type complete data copies reuse the existing initialized-leaf and stable-storage checks. Writable LOCATION aliases survive a complete copy while orientation aliases remain protected. Partially initialized copies fail before destination mutation.
rules.restriction: Because this release supplies no POSITION source constructor, complete-copy/protected-read tests explicitly seed synthetic orientation data in a host fixture. They establish offline copy/protection behavior only, not a KAREL initialization path, valid robot frame, rotation matrix or controller-equivalent operation.
rules.tests: tests/test_position_data.py: synthetic fixture is named seed_orientation and labeled as host-only evidence

rules.documented: XYZWPREXT has X/Y/Z/W/P/R REAL fields, CONFIG_DATA of CONFIG, and EXT1/EXT2/EXT3 REAL fields. All fields are read-write.
rules.implemented: Global/local declarations, nested structures, fixed/named arrays, exact-type references, scalar references and complete independent copies. Extra axes use the existing exact REAL checks. CONFIG subfields retain value-only argument behavior and conservative -8..7 turn guards. Source initialization can assign every leaf.
rules.restriction: XYZWPREXT remains distinct from XYZWPR and POSITION. No axis units, motion-group mapping, frame context, cross-type conversion, geometric operators or controller APIs are inferred.
rules.tests: tests/test_position_data.py and examples/position_data.kl: extra axes, initialization, copy/reference/array ownership and rejection controls

unresolved: POSITION source initialization and acquisition without invented orientation defaults
Robot/group joint-count and axis-unit mapping; JOINTPOS data support is recorded in joint_semantics.json
Frames, conversions, POS construction and cross-type positional conversion, relative/approximate operators, kinematics and robot configuration validity
Controller layout, task/alarm behavior, file/register access and execution

vector_update.boundary: Checked initialized VECTOR arithmetic, scaling/division, equality, cross/dot products; POSITION transforms and general rounding remain unsupported.

unpos_update.boundary: Exact XYZWPR extraction only; six REAL outputs plus CONFIG; disjoint references and preflight guards. No positional coercion, POS constructor or controller semantics.

vector_routine_update.boundary: Exact initialized VECTOR results and writable value copies are supported. Bare protected orientation arguments, effect/order guards and controller boundaries remain; positional values use positional_routine_semantics.json.

positional_routine_update.boundary: Exact initialized CONFIG/XYZWPR/XYZWPREXT/POSITION and exact-width JOINTPOS results/writable value copies are supported. POSITION protection, CONFIG scalar value-only passing, effects and conversion-context guards remain; no frame, kinematic or controller behavior is supplied.
